description: Expose each issue's createdAt (ISO 8601) as an additive field on cam issue list --json rows.

userStories.title: Emit createdAt on cam issue list --json rows
userStories.description: As the orchestrator consuming `cam issue list --json`, I need each issue row to carry its createdAt timestamp so that I can rank recency by real time instead of proxying it via the fragile id number.
acceptanceCriteria: BacklogJsonRow (src/issues/list.ts) gains a required `createdAt: string` field. [oracle: grep -q 'createdAt: string' src/issues/list.ts]
toJsonRow (src/issues/list.ts) emits `issue.createdAt` verbatim as a plain passthrough (no compute, no default, no optional-guard). [oracle: grep -q 'issue.createdAt' src/issues/list.ts]

createdAt appears on every row of both the `plannable` array and every `byStage` array of `cam issue list --json`, sourced verbatim from IssueEntry.createdAt (src/issues/types.ts:44). [oracle: bun test test/issues/list.test.ts test/issue-list.test.ts]
The human-readable `cam issue list` renderer is unchanged: only the --json path (deriveBacklogJson/toJsonRow) is touched; the date column stays out of scope. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

No schema change and no backfill: scripts/cam/issues.schema.json is not edited and no issue file is rewritten. [oracle: file-assert git diff --name-only shows neither scripts/cam/issues.schema.json nor scripts/cam/issues/* changed]

Exact-shape test assertions are updated to include createdAt: the row toEqual assertions in test/issues/list.test.ts (~:348, :356) and test/issue-list.test.ts (~:394, :396-397, :442, :494), plus the top-level Object.keys(parsed).sort() assertion at test/issue-list.test.ts:391 if row-key-order coverage requires it. [oracle: bun test test/issues/list.test.ts test/issue-list.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single-concern additive change. Files: src/issues/list.ts (BacklogJsonRow interface ~:158-163, toJsonRow ~:188-190); test updates in test/issues/list.test.ts and test/issue-list.test.ts. IssueEntry.createdAt is a required non-optional string (src/issues/types.ts:44), so a plain passthrough is correct: do NOT compute, default, or optional-guard it. Gotcha: toEqual row assertions and the top-level Object.keys(parsed).sort() shape assertion (test/issue-list.test.ts:391) WILL fail until updated in the same change. No non-test module consumes BacklogJsonRow, so the output-contract change is safe. Do NOT touch the human-readable renderer, the schema, or any issue file.
